name: @educateos/academics
description: EducateOS AcademicDirectory: schools, terms, catalog courses, offerings and enrollments behind a storage interface (in memory, on D1 with the migrations in `migrations/`, or in a Durable Object's SQLite at `./durable-object-store`), with source-of-record enforcement and a fetch-standard local fallback HTTP service and MCP-style tools over the same rules. A library, not a deployable Worker.
